method: PLANNING-POSITIVE anchors only = PLANNING_STRATEGIC_SOURCE + USER_REQUIREMENT + PROJECT_METADATA. Legacy positive (LEGACY_VISUAL_EVIDENCE, VISUAL_DIAGNOSIS, CREATIVE_HYPOTHESIS) tracked separately. LOCKED_IDENTITY tracked separately as constraint retention.

legacyPositiveLeakage.expected_at_strategic_stages: 0 at Need / Prompt / Synthesis (per spec). Observed: 0 at Need / Synthesis; 5 at Truth / 5 at Strategic Context / 5 at Prompt — all from VUC-inferred industry+brandRole reaching Truth via system_default + visual_understanding_core carriers.

constraintRetentionCurve.note: LOCKED_IDENTITY (locked.assets, locked.facts, locked.logo) is preserved from Truth to Prompt at 100% but the boolean logoLocked is not in v1 DVC projectFacts (Stage 3 partial).

comparisonWithCI7_3.interpretation: CI-W1C.7.3 measured LEGACY retention (high at DVC, drops at Evidence, near-zero at Synthesis). CI-W1C.7.3A measures PLANNING retention (zero at Planning Source, recovers at DVC+Truth, preserved to Prompt). The two metrics answer different questions. CI-W1C.7.3A's PLANNING curve correctly identifies the absence of planning data at Stage 1.

firstMaterialDrops.verdict: No planning source means no parsing happens; no content to lose.
The DVC layer INTRODUCES the user-typed brandName + lockedFacts content. This is not real planning; it's the system re-using project metadata.
3 USER_REQUIREMENT anchors (logoLocked + 2 lockedFacts) lose their evidence rows. Evidence is a 4-row generic table; doesn't carry locked content.
Truth has all 4 anchors at full value (locked.facts stores the user-typed text directly).
All 4 anchors are referenced in need factRefs but the need STATEMENTS are generic (per CI-W1C.7.3). This is the GENERIC_NEED_COLLAPSE finding from CI-W1C.7.3, confirmed in the planning curve.
Strategic context re-derives the constraint content from Truth.
Prompt carries the same content as strategic context.

summary.firstMaterialLoss: 1 Planning Source = 0 (PLANNING_SOURCE_NOT_PRESENT). The pipeline is faithful from Stage 3 onward (DVC) because there's almost no planning content to lose.
summary.keyObservation: The PLANNING curve is structurally different from CI-W1C.7.3's LEGACY curve. CI-W1C.7.3 saw retention DROP from 100% to 6.5% (visual content losing value as it moved through pipeline). CI-W1C.7.3A sees retention RISE from 0% to 100% (constraint content being added by the DVC layer and preserved). The two curves tell opposite stories because they measure different content types.
